GET /api/partnernet/relationships/:id/ev.note: Party check (ownRelationship or inline): only partner_a_id or partner_b_id; anyone else (a third partner, a founder, an investor) gets 403 and nothing is written; no credentials 401. An admin or Super Admin passes, and the bypass writes one admin_audit_log row (partnernet_admin_bypass, naming the route); a party's own call writes none (D9040).
